hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card layout and competent toolbar styling show design intent, but the circle-pack view is cropped at the bottom edge, the bundled edges form an unreadable tangle at center, and the brown/green cluster colors lack a legend — functional but the core encoding fails the readability gate.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout size encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, and key functions on data joins; sunburst applies an extra scaleSqrt to the radial axis (cosmetic, not deceptive), and no bar/area baseline violations apply to this topology chart type.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing parameter sliders fire full 1500ms layout transitions on every `input` event with no debounce/throttle, and `updateLayout` never calls `.interrupt()` before creating a new transition, leaving `target_x`/`target_y` cleanup in `.on('end')` unreachable when transitions are superseded mid-flight.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Edge bundle convergence in the circle-pack center creates a dense tangle that obscures individual connections, and the 8-layout control bar adds navigational overhead, but the 3-color palette is restrained and clusters are spatially well-separated — animation quality across layout transitions cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
